summary: Supported AAP 2.6 migration paths: RPM to containerized, RPM to OpenShift, RPM to Managed AAP, containerized to OpenShift, and containerized to Managed AAP; nothing else is supported. The guide lists what to migrate, step-by-step workflows and open questions.
questions: Which AAP migration paths are supported?
